headline: BTS rule Japan, aespa China, RESCENE Korea on Melon chart
sub: Melon's Global-K chart reveals each country's No. 1 K-pop act

points.title: Key points
items: BTS No. 1 on the combined chart 59 of 143 days
BTS: only act to top all three platforms
RESCENE's 'LOVE ATTACK' led Melon for 61 days
BTS, aespa stayed in the Top 10 all 143 days

caption:
BTS in Japan, aespa in China, RESCENE in Korea — Melon just revealed who ruled K-pop in each country this year.

Melon's new Global-K chart combines Melon (Korea), Tencent Music (China) and LINE MUSIC (Japan). From May 11 to Sep 30, BTS topped the combined chart on 59 of 143 days and were the only act to hit No. 1 on all three platforms. In Korea, RESCENE's chart-climbing 'LOVE ATTACK' spent 61 days at No. 1.

📌 Source: Melon report (via Korean media)
